review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 preserve the original contract: synchronous/asynchronous exposeHeaders callbacks receive the raw request Origin and same-request Context, run once for normal and OPTIONS requests, omit the expose header for empty results, propagate asynchronous failures through the existing error channel, and preserve existing CORS behavior. The exact writable source/test scope is sufficient; the supplied build configuration establishes that published declarations are generated, not separately maintained owners. The test script explicitly separates TypeScript checking from runtime tests, and the scoped test file is included by both configurations. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY match the specification. Their distinct allowed agents have the relevant active project-scoped trusted claims, delivery roles, assignability and capacity; eligibility does not depend on Persona or pending claims. The configured verifier can satisfy the supplied read-only planning-review policy. No material unresolved DEC-001 is present in this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate. Repository identity, base commit and supplied file fingerprints are consistent. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, with the differing manifest/evaluation source digest domains and executing-bundle prompt fingerprint explicitly explained. Historical operations do not establish candidate results for this bundle or invalidate retained project-scoped claims. Original preparation placeholders do not override the supplied frozen preview. This assessment uses only supplied review evidence, accepts the Service's mechanical digest bindings, and neither independently recomputes digests nor claims code execution, human attestation, task approval or dispatch.
